[{"insert":"1 1/4 Cyclist Back Squat

The 1 1/4 cyclist back squat is your main lift to open the week. It adds a quarter rep at the bottom of every rep — squat all the way down, come up a quarter, drop back to the bottom, then stand all the way up to finish. Raising your heels keeps the work almost entirely on your quads, and that extra quarter doubles your time in the hardest part of the squat. Reps drop every other week so the weight can climb.
"}]
